answers.core: This is part of the core configuration of any project just like the new "Importer Defaults". It could possibly be done via an add-on that re-imports newly detected files with a chosen importer, but that would be quite hacky and inefficient.
answers.workaround: Not really, this needs to be a configuration that affects what happens even before a given file is imported when scanned by the FileSystem dock.

title: Allow defining what importer to use for a given file extension
